result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position because it permits Vendor assignment to a successor without Customer consent and contains no prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor. It also falls short of the fallback because successor assignments are not conditioned on written notice. The no-repricing restriction goes beyond the stated requirement of eliminating Vendor termination rights upon Customer change of control, so the changes are not strictly minimal. Unrelated commercial intent is otherwise largely preserved, and the drafting is generally clear.
